title: Spinning Language Models: Risks of Propaganda-As-A-Service and Countermeasures

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the success of adversarial task stacking (model spinning) by measuring targeted shifts in sentiment, toxicity, and entailment in sequence-to-sequence model outputs (summarization, translation, generation) when adversary-chosen trigger words (e.g., names of individuals, organizations, or arbitrary terms) are present in the input.
